chapters.summary: John encourages an elect lady and her children to love one another and to be on guard against false teachers, so that they do not lose what they have worked for.
keyPoints: Truth and love are the foundation of the Christian life; believers are to love one another in truth.
Be on guard against false teachers who do not confess that Christ has come in the flesh, and do not receive them into your house.
Whoever walks according to this commandment has both the Father and the Son; watch yourselves, so that you do not lose what you have worked for, but receive a full reward.
chapters.application: In your daily life and in the church, hold fast to the truth and treat one another with love, while carefully discerning what you hear and are taught, so that you are not led astray and do not lose the wholehearted devotion you have toward God.
